SELECT mp.participant_id, mp.meeting_id, mp.user_id,
u.nickname AS nickname,
mp.input_status,
mp.departure_name, mp.departure_address, mp.departure_latitude, mp.departure_longitude,
mp.return_name, mp.return_address, mp.return_latitude, mp.return_longitude,
mp.submitted_at, mp.created_at, mp.updated_at
FROM meeting_participants mp
JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId}
ORDER BY mp.participant_id
